how: Written by validate/dim6_index.py from the released UFOs.  models: model -> coefficient -> 'one', the field contents (sorted labels of build/vertex_index.json, no Goldstone bosons or ghosts) of the vertices with a coupling of interaction order NP=1 that the coefficient moves, by name or through an internal parameter of the model (the four coefficients of the input relations by name alone), 'rescaled', those of them where no coupling names the coefficient, Standard Model vertices that it moves through the normalisation of a field, and 'two', those of the couplings of order NP=2 that multiply the coefficient by a second one or by itself (a linear vertex times an input shift or a field normalisation) and that are not under 'one'.  Every coefficient of the model's block DIM6 has an entry.  gen/process.py select_dim6 and ./dim8 select read it.
